keyFindings.description: The sentence telling authors to keep `!== "chromium"` skips gives a false reason. It says such a skip 'says the test is desktop-only by design', but the skips' own reasons are mostly 'the viewport is set here, not by the project' (agents.e2e.ts:762/850/956/1004, which check the phone layout at 390 px in chromium), 'one browser proves …' and 'the recovery does not depend on the layout'. It also says the skip 'keeps it off any other project whose testMatch names its file', but none of the 11 files' skipped tests is selected by another project (webkit-iphone's grep matches no skipped agent-view title; firefox-download-navigation's grep picks only the shell.e2e.ts row that the skip at :117 lets through). What the skip actually does is mark the test for the first exception.

Both copies of the selection rule list the tag conditions ('… or say they cover the phone layout') without the exceptions this round added to AGENTS.md, so both now describe agents.e2e.ts:759/847/953/1001 and mention-composer.e2e.ts:443 (titled for the phone, untagged by design) wrongly. The Docs acceptance names README and the config comment. Cut both copies to a pointer to AGENTS.md, so the rule lives in one place.

'desktop width' and 'phone width' are not defined. keyboard-palette.e2e.ts:1039 sets 1024 px, which the app treats as compact (COMPACT_VIEWPORT_QUERY max-width 1279px) and not phone (PHONE_VIEWPORT_QUERY max-width 767px, web/src/features/shell/useDialog.ts:7,9). Name the threshold. 'When unsure, tag it … an extra phone test costs CI minutes' is false for a test under the third exception, which fails when tagged: say the sentence applies once the exceptions are ruled out.
The comment says the margin is 'the desktop rail on any project'. At 1440 px it is the desktop margin; it becomes the rail only after the test clicks Hide margin (:231).
